reviews.text: We have been needing to get some electrical work done on our house for sometime. We had an addition added to our house plus some old wiring issues that needed to be worked out. I had called several handy man services but most of them were not licensed or not bonded. I was happy to find out the Mr Electric had both of these. I was remodeling a bathroom and needed the electical switches and plugs replaced.   The communication from the company is fantastic.   They text you a link with the technician's profile so you know who is coming to the door.    The work was fast and clean.   Great service and I highly recommend. My technician was Bryan and he was articulate, thorough, professional, and did the job right.

Bryan was spot on time, very considerate, explained the repairs required & took care of them quickly. He exhibits what customer service is all about and is a true asset to the Company! Highly recommend Mr. Electric and especially Bryan for great service and fair rates! K. Gibbons, Lake Dallas

Full disclaimer: I did not hire the company, so I can't speak to the work, but they seem well-versed and knowledgeable.

They quoted me a price that was too much, almost when you suspect that the company doesn't want to do the work. I am only speculating on that last part as I am not sure if that was the case.
I got a second opinion, and the new company quoted me 75% less than Mr. Electric.

Bryan Fuentes, the electrician sent to my home, was not only professional but also polite and courteous. He did a wonderful job installing ceiling fans and a light fixture, left everything as clean or cleaner than it was. Will definitely be using his services again.

Super quick response time. On time! Very professional. Bryan F. was great! Dealt with our outlet quickly & explained the issue so we could be aware for future problems. Also, no service fees for coming over. Gave us a quick quote & got it done. Will definitely recommend.
They are very very expensive, charged $480 for replacing a $34.00 20amp circuit breaker which got jammed. Never gonna use Mr. Electric again. It took them 3 minutes to replace it.

They had to move a few things around in the garage to take a look at what needed to be done and didn't put anything back. Unprofessional and wanted and arm and a leg for their services.  They tack on a $50 dispatch fee for coming out.
I didn't feel I was  being taken advantage of by Bryan.  He explained in lamens terms so I could understand and pointed out faulty work done by a large competitor.  Will use them again
I would rate our experience with Bryan a 10! Very professional and knowledgable. Great cudtomer service.
Paz was very pleasant and professional to work with, he quickly remedied our electric issue, will call again!!
Great experience. Shawn was professional, thorough, and knowledgeable.
